summary: REQ-12 and REQ-13 appear implemented: the canvas transition duration is derived from the selected update interval and updates on interval change, and the Update Interval dropdown adds 10s/15s options with a slower default (5s). No backend changes are shown.

hallucinated_features.description: Default rendering mode set to 'cluster' in OrderbookHeatmapView.
